title: Forge a United Front of Dreams and Allies!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
You came today too, thanks a ton!!

Ever since that mock race,
Biko Pegasus piqued my curiosity even
more,
and I found myself dropping by to watch her
practice at every opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Phew... For the fans' sake,
I gotta hurry up and become
as cool of a horsegirl as Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What did you sayyy?! Trainer,
don't tell me
you don't know Carrotman?!
This is a disaster...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We can't just stand around,
we gotta dispatch to the scene!!
Meet me in the Trainer's Office after
school!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My hero—
Carrotman! We're gonna watch it together!!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"—That is why,
no matter how many times I fail...
for justice and everyone's health,
I will fight to the bitter end!!"

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Full of nutrition! Full of justice!
Carotene Charge—Carrotman!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Woooaaah... Carrotman!!
Man, his very first transformation is so
cool it gives me chills!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Well, what did you think, Trainer?!
Wasn't Episode 1,
'Envoy of Nutrition and Justice:
The Birth of Carrotman!', amazing?!

"Carrotman" turned out to be a superhero
tokusatsu show made for kids.
Seeing him rise again and again to stand
against evil really was inspiring...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Whenever I watch Carrotman,
I feel all this courage welling up inside me,
like whoosh!!
choice_data_list: I was on the edge of my seat when ...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
That's what makes Carrotman so great!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Carrotman isn't ridiculously overpowered
right from the start.
He takes hits, gets knocked down,
and almost loses—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—but he always gets back on his feet!!
Even if it's an enemy he might not be able
to beat, he never runs away!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And that's when he says that line!!
You know which one, right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ready, go! "I'm just—"

In that moment,
a sudden memory flashes through my mind.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
How's that?! I'm just getting started,
baby!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ? What's up? You look lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?! Like Carrotman?! Really?!

I tell her that seeing her bravely fight on
despite her small stature
truly made her look like a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yay!!
That means I'm just as cool as Carrotman,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
hey! What do you mean 'despite my small
stature'!
Sure, I might be little right now,
but I'm gonna grow huge in no time!
choice_data_list: Ah... Sorry, was that a sore subject?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah...
but that's just 'cause I haven't fully grown
yet.
I'm gonna train harder and harder so I can
fight right alongside Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough, I'll tower over everyone,
and once I master dirt,
I'll take on turf next—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—It's fine, I can still catch up!!
For now,
I just gotta run my absolute hardest!
If I do that, I know I'll...!

Seeing her desperately try to reassure
herself leaves me at a loss for words.
Biko Pegasus is already plenty 'cool' just
the way she is.

And that is exactly why...
I want to help her shine even brighter.
I've been watching her for so long;
I'm confident I understand her charms better
than anyone.

I know I could get her onto the turf course
she's been longing to run on.
And above all else—
choice_data_list: (I want to make this girl's dream ...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's the matter? Why'd you go quiet... Oh,
are you that eager to see Episode 2?!

Still... as a rookie,
do I really have what it takes to guide an
Umamusume's racing career?
I don't know if I have the courage for
that—

Suddenly,
memories of that practice race rush back to
me.

The 'little' Biko Pegasus standing tall
against far 'larger' opponents.
Without flinching,
without giving up—full of courage.

Remembering that—
I feel courage welling up within my own heart,
too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here, I already started Episode 2!
Episode 2 is amazing—
it's when the rival who later becomes his
ally shows up—
choice_data_list: Will you let me be your ally?!
Will you let me be your ally?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, an ally... Wait, WHAT?!
Trainer, you want to be MY ally?!
choice_data_list: I think I can help you run on turf...

text_block_list.text:
Even if it isn't an official contract just yet,
if I can oversee her training closely,
I'm sure Biko Pegasus's talents will
blossom.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm still so tiny, though...
Can I really catch up?
Do you honestly think I can run on turf
starting right now?!
choice_data_list: We'll work hard together to make i...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Together...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Then as of today, Justice Biko
hereby enters into joint combat operations
alongside her new 'Ally'!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Thanks a million, Trainer!!
From here on out,
let's give it everything we've got
together!!
